messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — Asia demo next Tue 09:00-12:00 SGT needs 8x A100s for ~3h. Current vendor dashboards show fragmented slots. Can infra/vendor-ops coordinate a cross-vendor capacity swap and confirm invoice timing? cc @vendor-ops :eyes:
maria: Which region exactly? asia-southeast1 or asia-east1? Also which model/config — if sequence length is short we could fall back to H100s for part of the window.
leo: Need billing tag and project id to attach. Also we should pre-create a transient pool with the right node selector. Example snippet:```hcl
resource "redwood_vendor_pool" "demo_temp" {
  vendor = "vendor-b"
  gpus = 8
  tags = ["proj-demo-203", "cost-center:eng-demos"]
}
```
vendor-ops: We can shift capacity between vendor-b -> vendor-a but need 24h notice for physical slot handover. We can allocate 4 A100 now and 4 A100 in a phased swap at +18h. Invoice note: we issue a proforma within 48h and final invoice at month end unless you request immediate billing. If you need PO, please attach it now.
infra-bot: Automated check: vendor-a has 6x A100 free (unreserved), vendor-b has 3x A100 free, vendor-c has 10x H100 free. Confidence: medium. (run `/infra capacity-scan --region asia-southeast1`)
jana: Quick ask from PM side — what's the estimated cost delta for phased swap vs single-vendor? We need a go/no-go for demo ops calendar today. Also please fill the short allocation form: https://redwood.internal/forms/allocation-request?demo=asia
ashwin: (typo, meant ashwin) I'll put up the PO and fill jana's form. Project id: proj-demo-203. Region: asia-southeast1. Model: gpt-large-ish, typical seq_len 1024.
maria: Smoke test command to run once pool is ready: `REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./tools/smoke-run --region asia-southeast1 --model gpt-large-ish --tokens 512 --concurrency 4`
leo: I'll own canary for the 09:00-10:00 slot. Will join handover 08:30 SGT.
vendor-ops: Allocation created: ALLOC-3982 (temp pool, 4x A100 vendor-a immediate, 4x A100 vendor-b scheduled at +18h). PO received and attached to ticket #4521. Proforma queued, final invoice scheduled EOM unless you confirm immediate charge.
ashwin: Perfect — thanks. Can you post here once proforma is out so finance can pre-approve? Also ping if any slot fails to materialize.
vendor-ops: Proforma sent to finance@redwood.com and assigned invoice ref INV-PF-7621. Will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
